History of IEEE ATME

  • IEEE-Organized Competitions: The college has hosted events such as the "State Level Technical Project Exhibition," where students showcased their innovative projects. Notably, projects like the "Automated Waste Segregator with Composter" have won accolades for their practical
  • Hackathon Success: ATME students secured third place in the "InnovIndia: 2.0" hackathon, organized by Young Indians (Yi), Mysuru Chapter. This 24-hour virtual hackathon challenged participants to develop solutions for social impact, and the team from ATME was recognized for their project titled "Dementia Decliners."
  • Toycathon 2021: A team from ATME was shortlisted in Toycathon 2021, an event organized by the Ministry of Education’s Innovation Cell, for their idea on "Automatic Door Knob Sanitization using UV-C " This demonstrates their innovation in the field of physical toys with a focus on health and safety.
  • Project Competitions: The college's students also won first place in a National Level Project Competition for their work on a "Smart PPE Kit for Healthcare Workers," highlighting their commitment to addressing real-world problems through engineering

The IEEE Student Branch at ATME College of Engineering has played a significant role in fostering a culture of innovation, technical expertise, and leadership among students since its inception. The branch is part of the global IEEE organization, which is dedicated to advancing technology for the benefit of humanity.

These achievements underline the active participation and success of ATME College of Engineering in various technical and innovation-driven platforms.
